elaine: Hey — hitting intermittent 401s in the ruby sampleapp when tokens rotate under load. Minimal repro below, happens after a couple concurrent requests.

elaine: ```ruby
# sampleapp.rb (simplified)
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.chat.create(model: "gpt-mini", input: "hello")
# During rotation we see 401 and the request fails without a retry
```

devon: Which gem version? Does the retry middleware run for streaming vs normal paths? :thinking:

elaine: v0.9.2 (rubygems). Relevant log:

elaine: ```
[2026-03-15T11:02:02Z] INFO request_id=abc123 POST /v1/chat -> 401 Unauthorized (auth-service)
[2026-03-15T11:02:02Z] ERROR request_id=abc123 Redwood::Errors::Unauthorized: Token expired
```

devon: Ah — we purposely stopped auto-retrying 401s for streaming to avoid duplicate event semantics. Looks like the sampleapp streaming path didn't get the non-streaming parity change. For non-streaming endpoints we should refresh+retry once. I'll open a fix PR to unify behavior.

sam: I opened a PR that wires refresh+retry into the stream resume path and adds a small integration test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/838

ci-bot: CI: ruby-unit — flaky failure on 3.2 matrix, rerun queued

devon: Nice. Can you add an e2e that mocks the auth service and asserts exactly one resend? Also update CHANGELOG and add a note for SDK parity with Go/JS.

elaine: Will do tomorrow; for now workaround is `export REDWOOD_RETRY_401=true` in sampleapp.

sam: Once CI is green :shipit: — also pinging @eng-runtime to make sure runtime fallback semantics are compatible.

devon: Thanks — assigning to devex for follow-up and I'll include this in our SDK parity board.
